comments.mergedPostDetails:
Repro Steps
`Step 1: Open your action menu and open up any other nested layer that isn't the top default`
`Step 2: Close action menu and open QM`
`Step 3: Now close QM and open up your action menu again`
You'll see that you're back on the topmost default layer with Options, Expression, and Emotes.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
If you have the radial menu opened in any sort of sub menu, when you open the Quick Menu and go back in, the radial menu is reset back to the main position.
How to do yourself:
1. Open radial menu and go somewhere into your submenus
2. Open QM
3. Close QM
4. Open radial menu
5. Be sad that now you have to go find wherever you were last
